answers.question: Why have you chosen to apply to Acme Analytics?
answers.text: Acme's focus on using data to improve public transit access lines up with why I got into analytics in the first place - I want my work to have a visible, everyday impact.

answers.question: How <company> aligns with your personal aspirations?
answers.text: I'm looking for a graduate program with structured mentorship and rotational exposure across teams, which is exactly how Acme's program is set up.
